importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Marine Mammal Protection Act of 1972 to require the Secretary of the Interior to issue permits for importing certain legally harvested polar bear trophies from Canada.

label: H.R. 6251

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by Voice Vote.

title: To amend the Marine Mammal Protection Act of 1972 to allow importation of polar bear trophies taken in sport hunts in Canada before the date the polar bear was determined to be a threatened species under the Endangered Species Act of 1973.
